verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to network volumes without launching a Pod, and its open-source runpodctl CLI can transfer files between a local system and Runpod. Data transfer is also cheap to use, with no ingress or egress fees. Missing for 10: any documented cloud-storage sync integration, detail on S3 API coverage or transfer performance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the transfer tooling.
